Low.label: Low
Low.description: Minimal risk. No immediate action required. Monitor for further signals.

Medium.label: Medium
Medium.description: Moderate risk. Analyst review recommended within 4 hours.

High.label: High
High.description: Elevated risk. Analyst must review and act within 1 hour.

Critical.label: Critical
Critical.description: Confirmed or near-confirmed coordinated attack. Immediate action required. Escalate to AFM.
